#!/bin/bash
# Pterodactyl Auto-Cloner for Nighty Headless
set -e

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

GIT_URL="${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://github.com/lord-m1nx/nighty-pterodactyl-headless.git}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"

echo "==> Cloning Nighty Headless from: ${GIT_URL} (branch: ${BRANCH})..."
TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BRANCH" "$GIT_URL" "$TMP_DIR"

echo "==> Deploying files into server..."
shopt -s dotglob
for file in "$TMP_DIR"/*; do
    fname=$(basename "$file")
    if [ "$fname" = ".git" ]; then
        continue
    fi
    # Do not overwrite Nighty.exe or existing .env if server is reinstalled
    if [ "$fname" = "Nighty.exe" ] && [ -f "/mnt/server/Nighty.exe" ]; then
        continue
    fi
    if [ "$fname" = ".env" ] && [ -f "/mnt/server/.env" ]; then
        continue
    fi
    cp -rf "$file" /mnt/server/
done
shopt -u dotglob
rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"

# Ensure scripts have execute permissions
chmod +x /mnt/server/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x /mnt/server/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true

echo "=========================================================="
echo "  Installation complete!"
echo "  NEXT STEP: Upload your licensed 'Nighty.exe' to root"
echo "  and click Start!"
echo "=========================================================="
